name: map-watermark
title: Map Watermark
description: Text watermark overlay for maps with configurable position and styling.

files.content:
"use client" import type { ReactNode } from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" type MapWatermarkPosition = | "center" | "top-left" | "top-right" | "bottom-left" | "bottom-right" | "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right" type MapWatermarkProps = { children: ReactNode position?: MapWatermarkPosition className?: string } const DEFAULT_POSITION: MapWatermarkPosition = "center" const POSITION_CLASSES: Record = { center: "inset-0 items-center justify-center", top: "inset-x-0 top-0 items-start justify-center pt-4", bottom: "inset-x-0 bottom-0 items-end justify-center pb-4", left: "inset-y-0 left-0 items-center justify-start pl-4", right: "inset-y-0 right-0 items-center justify-end pr-4", "top-left": "top-0 left-0 items-start justify-start p-4", "top-right": "top-0 right-0 items-start justify-end p-4", "bottom-left": "bottom-0 left-0 items-end justify-start p-4", "bottom-right": "bottom-0 right-0 items-end justify-end p-4", } export const MapWatermark = ({ children, position = DEFAULT_POSITION, className = "text-[8rem] font-extrabold leading-none tracking-tighter text-black/10 dark:text-white/10", }: MapWatermarkProps) => { const positionClass = POSITION_CLASSES[position] return (
{children}
) }
